note: The crawl dataset is too large for git. These files live in a public Vercel Blob store under content-addressed paths; `npm run data:pull` downloads and verifies them, `npm run data:push` uploads a re-crawl and rewrites this file. Point DATASET_BASE_URL (or baseUrl here) at your own store to fork the data.
